metrics.name: Monthly recurring revenue
metrics.definition: The value of all paid subscriptions, each taken as one month of its price, on the last day of the month.
metrics.period: as at the last day of the month

metrics.name: MRR
metrics.definition: The monthly price of the subscriptions that were signed in the month, including the ones that have not started.
metrics.period: as at the last day of the month

metrics.name: New subscriptions
metrics.definition: The subscriptions that started a first paid term in the month.

metrics.name: Recurring revenue and new subscriptions
metrics.definition: The recurring revenue and the new subscriptions of the month, added for the board line.

metrics.name: Trial conversion rate
metrics.definition: The share of the trials that began in the month that turned into a paid subscription.
metrics.numerator: trials that turned into a paid subscription

metrics.name: Paying accounts
metrics.definition: The accounts with a paid subscription on the last day of the month.

metrics.name: Average seats
metrics.definition: The average number of seats on a paid subscription on the last day of the month.
